description_en: Set to 1 to stop a background session's running background shell commands and dynamic workflows when the supervisor stops, restarts, or updates that session's process, instead of handing them to the session's next process. Affects only that handoff: backgrounding a session with ← or /background still carries in-flight work over, and CLAUDE_DISABLE_ADOPT turns off both. Requires Claude Code v2.1.196 or later
description_ja: 1に設定すると、バックグラウンドセッションのプロセスが停止・再起動・更新される際に、実行中のバックグラウンドシェルコマンドや動的ワークフローを次のプロセスへ引き継がずに停止させます。
use_case_ja:
- デフォルトではセッションプロセスの中断後もタスクは維持され、再開時に継続されますが、リソース解放などの目的でこれらを強制終了したい場合に1を指定します
- セッションを中断（←キーまたは/background）した際の引き継ぎには影響せず、あくまでプロセス更新時のハンドオフのみを無効化します
- Claude Code v2.1.196以降で利用可能です
doc_snippets: Once a session finishes and sits unattached for about an hour, the supervisor stops its process to free resources. A session you have pinned with Ctrl+T is exempt and keeps its process running while idle. The transcript and state stay on disk either way, and the next time you attach, peek, or reply to a stopped session, the supervisor starts a fresh process from where it left off. When every session has finished and no terminal is connected, the supervisor itself exits and starts again the next time you need it. Background shell commands and dynamic workflows the session started keep running when its process is stopped, restarted, or updated, including on Windows. The next process started for that session picks them back up, a shell command that finished in the meantime is reported as completed with its output, and a workflow resumes from where it left off. Shell commands started by a subagent and running monitors still stop with the process, and deleting the session stops everything it handed off. To stop background shell commands and workflows with the process too, set the CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_EXIT_HANDOFF environment variable to 1 . If a restarted session comes back showing only its original prompt because Claude Code misread its transcript as empty, the conversation transcript is renamed with an suffix instead of deleted, so it stays on your machine.

Version Change v2.1.196 A single ← press backgrounds a foreground session; earlier versions required two presses, with a footer hint and a confirm. --dangerously-skip-permissions passed to claude agents shows the bypass disclaimer instead of being silently dropped. Interactive sessions you never named carry a default name such as my-app-3f in session listings and claude agents --json . Background shell commands and dynamic workflows survive the session's process being stopped, restarted, or updated, including on Windows; set CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_EXIT_HANDOFF=1 to turn the handoff off. A transcript misread as empty on restart is renamed with an suffix instead of deleted. v2.1.195 In-flight work carries over when you background a session on Windows too; set CLAUDE_DISABLE_ADOPT=1 to stop it instead. The Completed group fills the remaining vertical space and the header compacts on short terminals. An older Claude Code version no longer drops newer sessions' state.json fields or hides those sessions from claude agents . Attaching to a stopped session switches immediately instead of showing a blank screen for up to five seconds. A supervisor that can't accept connections exits and releases its lock on its own. v2.1.174 Background sessions no longer inherit gateway endpoint variables such as ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL from the supervisor's launch shell; the supervisor supplies a fresh credential snapshot to pre-warmed workers, fixing spurious Could not resolve authentication method errors. v2.1.172 /model in the dispatch input sets a session-scoped dispatch model override.
